Stored triplet-file mining mode, initially replace. It describes persistence behavior, not whether negatives are random, semi-hard or hard. Verify the actual mining consumer and the separate triplets_mine_mode setting before relying on an edit; changing this string does not select a negative-sampling curriculum. Schema default: "replace".

Stored chat UI default-model value. The current chat route uses chat.litellm.default_model when no request override is supplied, and the frontend does not read this UI field. Changing it alone does not change answering behavior. Configure the gateway default alias or choose the supported conversation override to select the actual route. Schema default: "ragweld-local".

Message-count limit used by the chat UI's restored history handling, constrained to 10–500. More history preserves longer local conversations but increases browser rendering and storage work; less keeps the interface lighter. This UI limit is separate from Recall's stored corpus, retrieval result count and the model's token budget. Schema default: 50.

Shows the chat answer's available confidence metadata as a badge. It changes presentation only and does not calculate a new probability or improve grounding. Use it as diagnostic context rather than a calibrated guarantee, especially when models or retrieval configuration change. Disabling it does not remove citations or prevent metadata from being returned. Schema default: false.

Displays the chat debug footer with available retrieval and generation diagnostics. Enable it for operator inspection of the actual response path; disable it for a quieter conversation view. It changes rendered diagnostic visibility, not trace capture, logging or provider routing. Schema default: true.

Initial visibility preference for the chat trace inspector. Enable it to make request routing and observability evidence easier to inspect; disable it to open chat with less diagnostic chrome. It does not disable trace capture or OTel export. The inspector's local open state can differ from this default during a session. Schema default: true.

Stored token-budget intent for extended thinking, constrained to 1000–100000. No current generation request consumer applies this UI field. Raising it does not allocate more reasoning tokens, increase model capability or enable thinking output. Use the implemented model/provider controls and inspect actual request metadata before attributing reasoning behavior to it. Schema default: 10000.

Stored binding-mode intent for an embedded editor. There is no active editor-service consumer applying this value. Changing it does not rebind a listener or expose an editor. A future deployment would need explicit listener, ingress and authentication configuration. Schema default: "local".

Stored preference for editor embedding. The current UI has no editor iframe consumer applying it. It does not alter Grafana embedding or open an editor window. A future integration would need a working editor URL and compatible frame/authentication policy. Schema default: true.

Stored enablement intent for an embedded editor integration. No current frontend/backend consumer launches or renders an editor from this flag. Enabling it does not install an editor or expose code editing. Use an actual implemented editor workflow before relying on this setting. Schema default: true.

Stored image reference intended for an embedded editor service. No active frontend or backend editor integration currently consumes this setting. Entering an image does not pull it, create a container or establish an editor URL. Treat it as stored intent until a concrete editor deployment and UI consumer are implemented. Schema default: "codercom/code-server:latest".

Stored embedded-editor port, constrained to 1024–65535. No current editor-service consumer binds this port. Changing it does not start a process or establish browser access. Coordinate any future editor listener with an implemented deployment and avoid conflicts with API/frontend/model ports. Schema default: 4440.

Stored description of the intended Grafana authentication setup. The current iframe consumer does not use this field to log in or attach credentials. Configure authentication and permitted embedding on Grafana and its ingress; setting a mode string does not create an authenticated browser session. Use the existing authenticated operator session and verify the actual embed. Schema default: "anonymous".

Serialized Dockview pane layout saved by the training studios and restored when a studio opens. It records pane arrangement rather than training parameters. A custom layout improves repeated operator workflows; malformed or unsuitable layout data can prevent useful restoration. Use the Studio layout/reset controls to manage it instead of manually crafting JSON. Schema default: "".

Stored preference for immersive full-height Studio presentation. The current Studio layout code does not consult this field, so toggling it does not change the rendered workspace. Use the implemented pane layout and preset controls for current presentation changes. It does not affect training or telemetry. Schema default: true.

Stored Studio-version enablement intent. The current frontend does not branch on this field and renders its implemented Studio directly. Disabling it does not restore an earlier interface or stop training. Use current layout controls rather than treating this as a version rollout switch. Schema default: true.

Stored preference to open a browser on startup. No current launcher or runtime consumer was found applying this saved field. Changing it does not open a browser tab or suppress one opened by an external launcher. Use explicit operator browser navigation for the deployed application. Schema default: true.

Deployment mode: development or production. Production activates protected configuration rules, including restrictions on model-routing edits, and corresponding UI controls reflect that policy. This is not an automatic deployment or hostname switch. Change it deliberately with the runtime configuration owner and verify the intended policy after saving. Schema default: "development".

Stored UI theme intent. The current theme hook reads its browser-local THEME_MODE preference rather than this saved configuration field. Editing Config Explorer therefore does not change the active browser theme. Use the implemented theme switcher to choose light, dark or automatic OS preference for that browser. Schema default: "dark".

Backend environment credential used by the Ragweld API to authenticate to its LiteLLM generation gateway. It is sent as a Bearer token on gateway requests and is distinct from upstream provider keys managed by LiteLLM. There is no public config default: a missing or empty key blocks generation-route resolution. Set a valid gateway client key in the backend environment, then verify authenticated gateway readiness. The Configured indicator only confirms a nonempty environment value; it does not prove the gateway accepts the key or that the selected model is available. The UI checks presence without exposing the secret value.
